feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Evidence: iteration 5 (five sensors at ±0.04 m, y = 0.06 m, wheel_track 0.095 m, mass 0.6 kg, kp 3.5, kd 0.6) scored 465.8. Its oval finish was 0.95, and its s-bend finish was 0.20 with max_error 0.0591 m, below the off-track limit. The s-bend failure is now line loss (0.95 events per run, 16 of 20 off track), so span is the likely limit. Iteration 1 showed that widening coverage cut s-bend line loss from 1.1 to 0.2. What I compensate for in the controller: with the sensors at ±0.05 m and weights kept at [-2,-1,0,1,2], the signal is about 20 percent less sensitive per metre, so I raise kp from 3.5 to 3.8 and hold kd at 0.6. Read the next race as follows. If s-bend line_loss_events falls below 0.7 and max_error stays at or below 0.06 m, keep the ±0.05 m span and test y = 0.07 m next. If s-bend line loss stays near 0.95, the cause is not span alone, so the next change is outer-sensor placement or the footprint size, not a wider row. If the oval finish falls below 0.9 with steering_oscillation above about 0.38, the edge gain is too high, so reduce the outer sensor x to ±0.045 m.
requested_changes: If s-bend line_loss_events stays near 0.95 with max_error near 0.06 m, try sensor_size 0.016 m with the ±0.05 m five-sensor row at y = 0.06 m. Evidence: iteration 5 lost the tape at the outer sensors (0.95 events per run), and larger footprints close the 25 mm coverage gap at the edge.

If line_loss_events falls below 0.7 but the oval finish drops below 0.9 with steering_oscillation above about 0.38, move the outer sensors to x = ±0.045 m with the same five-sensor count and y = 0.06 m. Evidence: iteration 5 oval finish was 0.95 with oscillation 0.23, and iteration 1 showed that wider coverage cut line loss.

If the s-bend finish rises above 0.2 with line loss below 0.7 and oscillation under 0.43, try y = 0.07 m with the ±0.05 m row and the same wheel_track 0.095 m and mass 0.6 kg. Evidence: iteration 5 shows forward offset from 0.04 to 0.06 m cut s-bend max_error below the off-track limit (0.0591 m) and raised the score from 327.8 to 465.8.
